generated.why: rendered output of another generated template, which escapes its own props (Latte og_include returns the HTML the included template produced)
Twig include() of a generated primitive (Button/Icon/Link/Text/Box): output of an autoescaped template; inline <svg> children are generator string literals, labels are piped through |e

slot of a primitive or organism: every `children` a generated block passes is a fragment it captured itself ({capture} / (string) $c_N, 3658 places in latte+twig blocks/); catalog blocks are rendered with ['p' => props] only (BlockRenderer::render), so `$children` is never a layout or data value (Fragment, Front and the compiled page pass props only; Layout::clean strip_tags + escapes strings and drops __html). codegen-x prints children raw on the server runtimes without a marker check (not changed in 832d7f17)

slot props of sub-templates (section-frame, page-header, panel, section-head, …; codegen-x since 41706af7): og_slot (Runtime::slot = Runtime::html) prints only the TrustedHtml marker that og_markup() made of a fragment the calling generated template captured; any other value — a plain string, also one a layout could put on a catalog block — is escaped. Checked by tests/CodegenSafetySharedTest (direct render with a plain string, Latte and Twig) and the fuzz; so no longer restricted to templates outside the catalog

TrustedHtml ({__html}) printed by og_html (Runtime::html): a non-marker value is escaped, a blank marker never reaches it (ReadPath |html and DataSources::trusted give null); markers come only from DataSources — the_content of the current post as is, every other {__html} (meta, records) through wp_kses_post (DataSources::trusted); layouts cannot carry __html (Layout::untrust)
inline SVG of a bundled Lucide icon looked up by name in icons/lucide-icons.json (unknown name → circle); attributes come from the bundled JSON
